sourceChecks.text: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the LORD’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of the LORD’s house to the Baals.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

profileDecisionJa: アタルヤはユダの王アハズヤの母として名を挙げられ、本文はオムリの娘と記します。
